description: Refund a payment, leave a note on the customer's HubSpot record and tell the support channel in Slack, each under a shared limit, with the refund and the note read back.

parameters.name: stripe_account
parameters.description: The Stripe account refunds are made from (acct_...).

parameters.name: stripe_mode
parameters.description: test or live. The key in STRIPE_KEY must be of this mode.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: The one currency refunds are made in, lowercase ISO code.

parameters.name: slack_channel
parameters.description: The Slack channel id support posts go to, e.g. C0123456789. Fixed at install, not chosen by the agent.

secrets.name: STRIPE_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe restricted key with refund write access, in the mode chosen above

secrets.name: HUBSPOT
secrets.description: HubSpot account whose contacts get the refund note

secrets.name: SLACK
secrets.description: Slack workspace with the support channel

actions.name: refund-payment
actions.description: Refund part or all of one Stripe payment, in minor units of the pack's currency. Stripe's own idempotency and the refund's read-back grade the receipt.

actions.name: post-to-support
actions.description: Post one message to the support channel fixed at install. Limitation: Slack answers HTTP 200 with ok:false on most errors, so a refused post is recorded succeeded and acknowledged; only the read-back, which finds no message, keeps it from confirmed.
